## Summary

Describe the consumer-facing problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Evidence

Include the fixture, command, or published-package behavior that proves the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] Tests cover a failing package and a clean counterexample when behavior changes
- [ ] Documentation reflects any public contract change
- [ ] No credentials, generated tarballs, or host-specific paths are included
